question: How does a pressure relief valve protect the hydraulic system?

options.text: By increasing the pressure for better performance

solution:
The correct answer is __By limiting maximum working pressure.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pressure relief valves__ are crucial components in hydraulic systems.
 
• They ensure the system operates safely by limiting the maximum pressure to prevent damage.
 
• When the pressure in the system exceeds the set limit, the valve opens to release excess pressure.
 
• This protects the components of the hydraulic system from overloading or potential failure.
 
• Pressure relief valves are designed to automatically reset once the pressure returns to normal levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydraulic Systems:**

 
 
• Used widely in industries for power transmission and control.
 
• Operate using fluid dynamics to generate force and motion.
 
 
 
• **Other Types of Valves:**
 
 
• Directional control valves: Manage flow direction in the system.
 
• Flow control valves: Adjust the rate of flow of hydraulic fluid.
